author: Gili90
quote: The game feels like The Sims; I’ve never played a GTA with so many restrictions, and on top of that, you’re tethered to the girl. I understand it took 13 years, but I think they took way too long to release a game like this—it’s as if the developers were more focused on making money than on their customers.
